requirement_text: Fachhochschulreife (university of applied sciences entrance qualification) is eligible for admission to Fachhochschule-type (applied sciences) programmes only. Holders may additionally sit the Delta examination to become eligible for university (Universität) Bachelor's programmes. The Delta examination is held once a year, in May, with a fee of €200.00.

requirement_text: With the title of master craftsperson (Meister) or equivalent advanced vocational training, applicants may apply for any degree programme with restricted admission. Applicants qualified through vocational training plus professional experience (without a Meister-equivalent title) must sit an aptitude test, held annually in May at the Studienkollegs in Heidelberg or Karlsruhe, with a fee of €200.00.

requirement_text: German C1 (“in accordance with the guidelines of the Standing Conference of the Ministers of Education and Cultural Affairs (KMK): German language skills for higher education entrance”): DSH 2 or 3, TestDaF 4 or 5, Goethe Certificate C2, Language diploma of the KMK level II (DSD II) with the results 4xC1 or 3xC1 and 1xB2, Assessment test, Telc Deutsch C1 Hochschule, German-language Abitur, or German as a mother tongue.

limitations: OSA (Online Study Choice Assistant International, osa.uni-freiburg.de) separately states general guidance of ‘at least level B2’ for German- or English-taught programmes — a lower bar than this C1 table. See companion record FRE0008; the two are recorded as an unresolved tension, not silently reconciled.
researcher_notes: This is the general C1-equivalency table the page presents institution-wide; the page itself says the actually-required level is set per programme (“Consult the selection statutes or admissions regulations of the particular degree programmes to find out which language certificates are required for admission to them”). C1 (DSH 2/3) is corroborated as the commonly-cited level by the separate general Admission Requirements page (‘If your native language is not German, you must also take a language test (e.g. DSH or TestDaF)’, which names DSH without a number, i.e. is consistent with but not independently specific to C1).

requirement_text: English C1: Cambridge CAE (C1) and CPE (C2); IELTS Academic (score of 7.0–8.0); PTE Academic (score of 76–84); TOEFL iBT (score of 95 or more) – the certificate is valid for two years; TOEFL iBT (score of 5.0–5.5 or more) – the certificate is valid for two years; TOEFL Essentials (score of 10 or more) – the certificate is valid for two years; OOPT (score of 80–99); telc B2-C1 University; TOEIC (score of at least 945 on ‘Listening/Reading’, 180 on ‘Speaking’, and 180 on ‘Writing’); UNIcert III or IV; or one of several listed exemptions (native speaker; nationality of a country whose official language is English; degree taught in English from a genuinely anglophone country; IB Diploma anglophone section; German/Luxembourgish Abitur with CEFR-level evidence on the certificate).
source_authority_note: uni-freiburg.de fails looksOfficial() (no .edu/.ac./.gov suffix) — this is the institution's own official page. Needs the officialDomains-provenance fix documented in source-authority-gap.md, not a lowered evidence bar.
limitations: Source page explicitly lists BOTH the new TOEFL iBT 1–6 scale (effective 21 Jan 2026, ‘5.0–5.5 or more’) AND the comparable 0–120 score (‘95 or more’) for the identical C1 level — this is the correct dual-disclosure pattern per ETS's two-year comparable-score transition (see scalar-thresholds-are-not-enough.md), NOT the Glasgow-style trap, since Freiburg states both explicitly rather than only a legacy figure. Per ETS's own transition policy, the 0–120 comparable score will stop appearing on score reports around January 2028, after which only the 1–6 figure will remain verifiable.
researcher_notes: Matches externally-reported Faculty of Engineering Master's thresholds (TOEFL iBT ~94/95, IELTS 7.0) found via search, which corroborates C1 as the commonly-applied level for English-taught Master's programmes. OSA's general ‘at least B2’ guidance (FRE0008) is a lower, differently-scoped figure — recorded as a tension, not resolved.
